basic_details.job_title: FSSAI Legal Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Posts

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: Not more than 58 years of age as on the last date of submission of the application.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | legal consultant: A Bachelor's Degree in Law on regular basis from a recognised University established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, or a State Act, or any institution for higher education deemed to be a university by the Central Government or any other institution or foreign University approved by the Central Government, with not less than 5 years of experience in legal matters. A degree obtained through Open University/ Distance Education mode will not be considered.

salary_details.details: There shall be a 5% annual increment applicable only if the contract is extended beyond 01 year from the date of appointment in FSSAI. No separate local allowances, HRA, or medical benefits are admissible.

selection_process: The selection process consists of shortlisting followed by a Walk-in Interview.
how_to_apply: Visit the official FSSAI website at fssai.gov.in.
Go to the jobs section and click on the link available for FSSAI Legal Consultant Recruitment 2026.
Ensure you fulfill all eligibility criteria before applying.
Fill out the application form with all required details.
Upload necessary documents in original or as requested by FSSAI.
Submit the application online on or before 22 October 2026.
Keep a printout or digital copy of the submitted application for future reference.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date and found incomplete will be summarily rejected. Applications should be submitted with contact number and email-id. Shortlisted candidates to be called for selection procedure would be informed through e-mail/telephone with a week's notice at least. Physical applications will not be entertained in any case and will be summarily rejected. Candidates must produce the relevant documents in original when asked for by FSSAI. The engagement is purely on contract basis initially for one year and may be extendable annually up to a maximum period of three years. Individual Consultants shall not be permitted to take up any other assignment during the period of consultancy with FSSAI. Police verification of the individual consultants shall be done as per the latest instructions issued by MHA.

content_sections.heading: FSSAI Legal Consultant Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notification announces a total of 3 vacancies for the post of Legal Consultant on a contract basis.

rows.qualification_required: A Bachelor's Degree in Law on regular basis from a recognised University established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, or a State Act, or any institution for higher education deemed to be a university by the Central Government or any other institution or foreign University approved by the Central Government, with not less than 5 years of experience in legal matters. A degree obtained through Open University/ Distance Education mode will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: FSSAI Legal Consultant Age Limit
content_sections.text: Not more than 58 years of age as on the last date of submission of the application.

content_sections.heading: FSSAI Legal Consultant Salary
content_sections.text: There shall be a 5% annual increment applicable only if the contract is extended beyond 01 year from the date of appointment in FSSAI. No separate local allowances, HRA, or medical benefits are admissible.

content_sections.heading: FSSAI Legal Consultant Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: FSSAI Legal Consultant Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of shortlisting followed by a Walk-in Interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for FSSAI Legal Consultant
content_sections.text: Visit the official FSSAI website at fssai.gov.in. Go to the jobs section and click on the link available for FSSAI Legal Consultant Recruitment 2026. Ensure you fulfill all eligibility criteria before applying. Fill out the application form with all required details. Upload necessary documents in original or as requested by FSSAI. Submit the application online on or before 22 October 2026. Keep a printout or digital copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: FSSAI Legal Consultant Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date and found incomplete will be summarily rejected. Applications should be submitted with contact number and email-id. Shortlisted candidates to be called for selection procedure would be informed through e-mail/telephone with a week's notice at least. Physical applications will not be entertained in any case and will be summarily rejected. Candidates must produce the relevant documents in original when asked for by FSSAI. The engagement is purely on contract basis initially for one year and may be extendable annually up to a maximum period of three years. Individual Consultants shall not be permitted to take up any other assignment during the period of consultancy with FSSAI. Police verification of the individual consultants shall be done as per the latest instructions issued by MHA.

faq.question: Q1. What is FSSAI Legal Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India to hire Legal Consultants on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for FSSAI Legal Consultant?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Legal Consultant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for FSSAI Legal Consultant 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 22 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for FSSAI Legal Consultant?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree in Law on a regular basis from a recognised university with not less than 5 years of experience in legal matters.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for FSSAI Legal Consultant?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be more than 58 years of age as on the last date of submission of the application.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for FSSAI Legal Consultant?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for FSSAI Legal Consultant?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the link available on the official FSSAI website on or before 22 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary of FSSAI Legal Consultant?
faq.answer: The fixed consolidated remuneration is Rs. 70,000 per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for FSSAI Legal Consultant?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Is distance education law degree accepted for this post?
faq.answer: No, a degree obtained through Open University or Distance Education mode will not be considered.
